faq.title: Common questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know before subscribing.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: Luxe Plus is an annual membership billed once per year. Your renewal date appears in your account under Membership. We do not auto-renew without your consent on your chosen payment method.

discount.question: When does the checkout discount apply?
discount.answer: The member discount applies automatically at checkout on eligible orders after any coupon codes you enter. It does not stack on top of the same promotion twice — coupons apply first, then your Plus savings.

returns.question: How do extended returns work?
returns.answer: Return windows are measured from the delivery date on your order. Free accounts get 30 days; Plus members get 60 days on delivered orders, subject to our standard return policy.

cancel.question: Can I cancel?
cancel.answer: Your membership stays active until the end of your paid term. We do not offer partial refunds for unused months, but you keep all perks until your expiry date.

payment.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
payment.answer: You can pay with your Luxe wallet balance, redeem a gift card code, or use credit/debit card via Stripe. Wallet and gift card subscriptions activate immediately; card payments activate once Stripe confirms payment.

giftCard.question: Can I use a gift card to subscribe?
giftCard.answer: Yes — enter your gift card code at checkout on this page. The card must cover the full annual membership price and be assigned to your account email.

faq.title: Questions sellers ask us
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before launching on Luxe.

payouts.question: How do payouts work?
payouts.answer: Payouts are deposited on a rolling schedule based on your plan. Track pending, available, and paid balances in the vendor dashboard on web.

commission.question: How much commission do you charge?
commission.answer: Starter is 12%, Growth is 8%, and Enterprise is negotiated. No hidden listing fees on Growth and above.

international.question: Can I sell internationally?
international.answer: Yes. Luxe supports cross-border selling with localized checkout and integrated carriers. You control which markets you ship to.

dashboard.question: Where is the vendor dashboard?
dashboard.answer: The full vendor panel runs on the Luxe web app — sign in there to manage products, orders, and payouts. This app covers shopping and seller marketing only.

approval.question: How long does approval take?
approval.answer: Most applications are reviewed within 2–3 business days. Complete profiles with verified business details are typically approved faster.

bulkImport.question: Can I import products in bulk?
bulkImport.answer: Yes. Use CSV import on Growth plans or connect via API on Enterprise. Map variants, inventory, and media in a single workflow.

variants.question: Do you support product variants?
variants.answer: Full variant support — size, color, material, and custom options — with per-variant inventory and pricing.

returns.question: How are returns handled?
returns.answer: Returns flow through the same order system customers use. You set policies per store; Luxe provides RMA labels and status tracking in your panel.

agreement.title: Luxe Seller Agreement
agreement.subtitle: Summary of key terms for marketplace sellers
agreement.body:
By selling on Luxe you agree to:

• Provide accurate product listings, pricing, and inventory
• Ship orders within stated handling times and honor your return policy
• Comply with applicable tax, consumer protection, and brand authenticity laws
• Keep customer data confidential and use it only to fulfill orders
• Accept Luxe commission and payout schedules for your plan

Luxe may suspend or remove stores that violate these terms or receive sustained negative buyer feedback.

This summary does not replace the full Terms of Service.
